title: Accordions and tabs drawn while they open
blurb: Five more controls from the ui-feed collection, rebuilt around native elements: an accordion of details beside a drawn bottle, a walk whose legs unfold contour maps, an order summary whose pictures move from a row to a column, a bus timetable on radio tabs, and a poster whose output is stretched to fill it.
question: Can a canvas draw a details element closing, when a closed one has no content in its picture, and how far can an element's picture be stretched?
result: Yes for closing, if the element stays open until the canvas has finished drawing it shut: the click on the summary is cancelled and the open attribute is removed at the end. An output 902 pixels wide was drawn at 0.36 of its width and stayed sharp in the test browser. Nothing here is verified on a phone.
